definitions.velocity: Equal-volume RMSE of Vp in m/s on all 501760 native 125-m truth centers; no smoothing
definitions.sphere: Each declared geometric sphere intersected with abs(truth-flat4 background)>1e-7 m/s, matching frozen region_masks
definitions.EM: Native 1-km constant Vp cells (nearest slowness), not trilinear cells
definitions.DD: Native padded trilinear Vp including fixed exterior nodes, NOT interpolated slowness
definitions.location: P90 Euclidean 3D error in metres, full catalog, equal event weights; NumPy linear quantile
definitions.EM_checkpoint: iter_11 saved E-step on pre-update velocity; final_model after 12 M-steps; no final relocation
definitions.soft_location: Primary table uses MAP; weighted-mean P90 supplied separately, never posterior expected distance
definitions.identity: EM event_j = source CSV row j; DD EVT_ prefix removed or original integer catalog ID, aligned explicitly
definitions.oracles: Velocity-only whole-volume L2 references, not inversions or per-sphere lower bounds
